checks.name: Host plugin and offline workspace UI
checks.detail: Chromium desktop and WebKit mobile emulation: signed installation, real Component execution, stop/update/rollback, local offline edit/commit and reopen.

checks.name: delete versus foreground typing
checks.detail: Delayed real Git deletion; newer editor input survives and recreates the file.

checks.name: plugin refresh versus foreground typing
checks.detail: Real reviewed Component proposal and delayed Git read; newer editor input remains a dirty draft.

checks.name: live GitHub Host publication
checks.detail: Chromium desktop and WebKit mobile emulation use real GitHub profile, repository and Git HTTP traffic. Device-code/token exchange is a test relay supplying an in-memory existing credential. Host opens the disposable branch, edits, commits, fetches, pulls, publishes and asserts exact remote SHA.

checks.name: static Host offline runtime
checks.detail: Verified separately in Chromium desktop and WebKit mobile emulation through local Wrangler Static Assets with CSP. Real Git object import, independently downloaded WIT Component, offline page reload, a fresh Git Worker, offline commit and cached Component execution. WebKit test defers native Service Worker registration until synthetic network fixtures complete because Playwright cannot intercept its controlled requests; it then asserts an active controlling production worker before all offline checks.

checks.name: static packaging
checks.command: pnpm build:browser && pnpm exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.jsonc
checks.detail: dist/proprium entry, hashed JS/CSS/Worker/WASM closure, security headers and offline precache; no application bindings.

checks.name: independent plugin release producer
checks.detail: Built and verified signed 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 with ephemeral signing keys, preserved both immutable versions, rejected duplicate version, then re-verified unchanged index.

checks.name: R2 publication planning
checks.detail: No-network plan resolves existing absolute local artifact paths to content-addressed R2 keys with WASM MIME and immutable cache policy.

checks.name: documentation and retained evidence
checks.detail: 15 maintained Markdown files have no missing local links; 2 immutable legacy evidence retention tests pass; git diff --check passes.

checks.name: signed registry replay and pinned-root rotation
checks.detail: A previously observed revocation cannot be undone by an older signed index; exact replay is allowed; same-version changed bytes or missing proof fails closed. New pinned roots have separate observed-version state and cannot reauthorize old cached install records. The 10 manager unit tests and 6 Chromium/WebKit plugin browser cases pass after these fixes.
